_doc: Player weapon handling (src/weapons.cpp stepWeapons). Dispersion: each shot leaves inside a cone of half-angle hip[class] or ads[class] (deg, ADS = adsT > 0.85; the sight-line path uses the same draw) x stance[stance]. Stance, first match wins: mounted (bipod deployed: a bipod weapon, prone or crouched, still), prone, crouched, sprinting (moving with Shift, not aiming), moving, standing (still). Recoil per shot: the weapon's own profile x recoil[stance] x 0.85 in ADS; mounted keeps the pre-overhaul values, the old posture factor (prone 0.20, crouched 0.70, in src/weapons.cpp) x the weapon's recoil.supported (its bipod factor; MG 42 prone 0.07), recoil.mounted only for a bipod weapon without one; standing still kicks pitch only, moving (any stance) adds movingYaw of the weapon's horizontal wander. classes: weapon id -> rifle / sniper / auto / lmg (unlisted: scope -> sniper, belt -> lmg, auto -> auto, else rifle). Bots keep their own aim model (content/ai).

recoil._yawNote: WP4c: every shot jerks the aim left or right (55 % left), size recoil.yaw x vmRecoil kind yawScale x 0.3..1.2 (15 % of shots twice that) x stance factor squared, moving x (1 + movingYaw); accumulated within +-8 deg

kinds._doc: WP4 visual recoil (viewmodel only; the aim displacement is each weapon's recoil.pitch / yaw / climb). Per shot a critically damped spring kick: back_m along the bore into the shoulder (dominant), pitch_deg muzzle up, left_deg a barely visible left nudge; omega (1/s) sets the attack (peak after 1/omega) and the return (settled ~5/omega); backMax_m caps the accumulated back travel (eye relief); flash: muzzle flash size. Bursts add impulses to the running springs. Stance scales them with the square root of the gameplay stance factor. WP4c: a clean straight push back along the bore is the clearly dominant motion (peak ~20 ms after the shot, settled ~100 ms), the muzzle rise a third of WP4's and the left nudge a trace; in ADS the push is along the sight line (capped at 70 % of the eye relief) so the sights stay on the centre line.

muzzleFlash._doc: WP4b muzzle flash look (Fx::muzzleFlash): HDR linear colours of the core (saturated yellow-orange), the orange petals and their darker orange-red rim; the brief point light at the muzzle (no shadow): colour, radius m and intensity at full (fades over the flash's 20-40 ms)
